meta.name: add-gcal-tool
meta.description: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool (list calendars, list/search/create events, free/busy queries) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported. Mirrors /add-gmail-tool's stub pattern — no raw credentials ever reach the container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把谷歌日历变成可调用的工具，自动管理日程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在工作流中查询或创建日历事件
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Calendar into a callable tool to manage schedules automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to query or create calendar events in your workflow

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以列出日历、搜索/创建/更新/删除事件、查询忙闲状态，并支持多个日历和账号。
howto.when: 当你要求查看、管理或查询 Google 日历事件时触发，例如“列出我的日历”或“下周一有什么安排”。

say.text: 下周一我的工作日历上有什么安排？
say.note: Claude 会搜索指定日历的事件。

say.text: 帮我创建一个明天下午3点的会议，标题为“项目评审”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can list calendars, search/create/update/delete events, query free/busy status, and supports multiple calendars and accounts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view, manage, or query Google Calendar events, e.g., "list my calendars" or "what's on next Monday?".

say_en.note: Claude will call the list-calendars tool to return all calendars.

say_en.text: What's on my work calendar next Monday?
say_en.note: Claude will search events on the specified calendar.

say_en.text: Create a meeting tomorrow at 3 PM titled 'Project Review'.
say_en.note: Claude will call the create-event tool to create the event.
